Title: Photokeratitis: Why Your Eyes Burn Hours After Sun Exposure

Description:
Photokeratitis is a UV sunburn on your cornea — symptoms can take 30 minutes to 12 hours to show up, so eye pain often hits in the middle of the night after a sunny day.

Tanning beds and welding arcs give off the same damaging UV as the sun. Wear wraparound UV400 sunglasses outdoors, protective goggles near tanning lamps or welding arcs, and rest your eyes in a dark room with preservative-free artificial tears if it flares up.
